Description: Verify a failing quote after a successful one removes the previous price, discount, rate and buy button, leaving only the error
Steps: Open GET /web/quote; tap 'vehicle-car'; enter '3' in 'months-input'; tap 'quote-button' | Change 'months-input' to '13'; tap 'quote-button'
ExpectedResult: Screen shows ['4500 THB', 'discount 0%', 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB', 'ซื้อเลย'] | Screen shows ['months must be an integer from 1 to 12']; 'quote-price', 'quote-discount', 'quote-monthly-rate' and 'buy-button' are empty/hidden

Description: Verify a second tap while the first request is in flight disables the button and clears prior output before the new answer arrives
PreRequisites: Mock: intercept POST /passes/quote to delay response 3000ms
Steps: Open GET /web/quote; tap 'vehicle-car'; enter '3' in 'months-input'; tap 'quote-button'; immediately tap 'quote-button' again while the first request is in flight
ExpectedResult: Screen shows ['ONODE Parking', 'ดูราคา']; 'quote-button' is disabled; 'quote-price', 'quote-discount', 'quote-monthly-rate', 'buy-button' and 'error-message' are all empty

ExpectedResult: Screen shows ['4500 THB', 'discount 0%', 'ราคาต่อเดือน 1500 THB', 'ซื้อเลย'] | Screen shows ['ONODE Parking', 'รถยนต์', 'มอเตอร์ไซค์', 'จำนวนเดือน', 'ดูราคา']; 'quote-price', 'quote-discount', 'quote-monthly-rate', 'buy-button' and 'error-message' are all empty
